overview: Host Michael Marks interviewed MWRA Executive Director Fred Lasky regarding water infrastructure and Bill O'Keefe regarding youth sports and the new city recreation department.

items.title: Introduction to Spotlight on Medford
items.summary: Michael Marks introduced the new community access television show and invited residents to utilize the station's new equipment and facilities.

items.title: MWRA Operations and Water Quality
items.summary: Fred Lasky discussed the history of the Boston Harbor cleanup, the status of regional water quality, and how infrastructure bonds drive local water and sewer rates.

items.title: Residential Water Safety and Conservation
items.summary: The discussion covered residential conservation tips, the availability of low-flow fixtures, and safety protocols for testing and flushing lead from home plumbing.

items.title: Local Infrastructure and Sewer Grants
items.summary: The host and guest reviewed Medford's implementation of leak detection technology and the use of MWRA funding to address inflow and infiltration issues in the sewer system.

items.title: Regional Water Projects and Maintenance
items.summary: Updates were provided on the new 20-million-gallon storage facility in the Middlesex Fells and planned rehabilitation work for major water and sewer lines on Riverside Avenue.

items.title: Medford Community Gardens and Boy Scouts
items.summary: Fred Lasky provided updates on the expansion of community garden plots across city parks and the civic engagement activities of local Boy Scout troops.

items.title: Youth Baseball and the Recreation Department
items.summary: Bill O'Keefe discussed upcoming Little League tryouts and explained how the city's new Recreation Department will help centralize scheduling for youth sports organizations.

items.title: American Legion Post 45 and Veterans Programs
items.summary: The segment highlighted youth sports events hosted at the American Legion and the long-standing tradition of placing flags on veteran graves at Oak Grove Cemetery.
